text:
sam: RFC addendum: lightweight staged-decrypt resume protocol for air-gapped model shards. aim: avoid 2x disk blowup during decrypt and allow mid-stream resume if keys expire. PTAL.

rebecca: short version: stream-decrypt shards to staging, verify per-shard hash, mark CANDIDATE, flip tiny activation marker. good to reduce downtime.

tony: agree. need shard-level integrity: include sha256 and merkle_root in manifest.

security: threat model note: appliance must authenticate. require cert pinning + signed manifest + per-shard HMAC.

sam: implementation notes: appliance pushes with Content-Range: POST /v1/appliance/push/{model}/{shard}?offset=.. and header X-Push-Nonce. agent computes streaming MAC and resumes by sending last-offset in response.

rebecca: how do we handle key TTL mid-decrypt?

sam: agent pauses decrypt, persists offset and partial plaintext, signals operator via `WAITING_FOR_KEY`. CLI `rctl keys unseal --node X --model Y` resumes. agent validates new unseal and continues.

ton: rollback: keep previous_active_model_id and reverse index of previous shards locations. rollback sets marker to previous_active_model_id and serves from cache if present. if missing, operator alerted `rollback_requires_resync`.

sre: eviction/pressure: agent config: staging_capacity_bytes, low_disk_threshold_pct. eviction policy LRU+pin. agent stops new decrypts when free < threshold.

sam: resume token: HMAC(model|shard|offset|nonce) signed by appliance key to prevent replay. agent validates against manifest allowed nonces.

security: require per-shard signed descriptor in manifest or merkle leaf proofs. agent refuses out-of-manifest shards.

eng-bot: metrics to add: model_stage_bytes_decrypted_total, model_staged_shards_count, model_lazy_fetch_failures_total.

rebecca: operator UX: `rctl model promote --canary 5 --priority-cutoff P1 --dry-run` to stage on subset. CLI shows staged percent per-node.

tony: appliance change minimal: chunked POST with Content-Range + resume semantics. include example in RFC.

sam: migration: bundles without shard map treated as single-shard legacy path. agents use legacy flow for compatibility. full RFC addendum to include schema, example manifest snippet, and runbook. posting in 72h.

security: tagging security for final pass on HMAC formats and keystore policies.

eng-bot: created tracking issue INF-1434.

rebecca: LGTM, will review addendum when posted.

sam: thanks all :thumbsup:
